{{Quote|Okay, ''verd'ika'', is it ''gi'' dumpling soup, or red gourd?''"<br />"''Gourd, please.|[[Enceri cantina]] [[Unidentified female bartender|bartender]] and [[Fi Skirata]]|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''Red gourd soup''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-made soup, the main ingredient of which was [[red]] gourd. Red gourd soup was one of the dishes served at a [[Enceri cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Enceri]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the wounded former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], [[Fi Skirata]], ordered a bowl of red gourd soup at the Enceri [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] for himself and his girlfriend, [[Parja Bralor]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red gourd soup made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2008]] novel, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
